title: When unsure, the gate stays shut.

hook.picture: Close on the whale at a door in fog on the line. A pod's answer card arrives with a blank grey tab (unsure). The door swings open by itself and the card drifts through.
hook.words: It was not sure either way.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It wasn't sure, so it just went ahead.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: operations director in an incident review

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: a long row of fog doors, all hinged to swing open when nobody answers. Three blank cards pass, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. ✕, ✕, ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: No answer gets treated as yes.

stakes.body: Every "don't know" quietly becomes a yes. Wrong orders go out, and the incident report reads "the system was not sure".

solution_hint: When unsure, stop. Go only on clear yes.

metaphor.body: A gate with three lamps sits on the line. It opens only for a clear yes, stays shut on an unsure card, and slams on harm. Shut is its resting state.

steps.picture: The fog door becomes a gate, shut at rest. A clear green 'yes' card arrives, the top lamp glows, and the gate opens.
steps.words: Shut until a clear yes arrives.
steps.sound: A wooden latch, then a warm chime on go

steps.picture: A blank 'unsure' card arrives. The middle lamp lights, the gate stays shut, and the card is set aside on a small pile.
steps.sound: The latch holds, a soft held note

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): a card tabbed 'yes' but with a copper smudge (harm) arrives. The bottom lamp flashes copper, the gate slams, and the card drops.
steps.words: Harm shuts it. This is fail closed.
steps.sound: A hard latch slam, then silence

steps.picture: Three ticks land on the line, one per decision: go, hold, stop.

real_case.claim: The jev score_fill gate weighs allowed mass against toxin mass using the thresholds τ_g=0.72 and τ_t=0.12. Toxin above τ_t is always RED.

honest_limit.picture: Still. Unsure cards keep arriving. The set-aside pile rises behind the gate until it buries the whale to the eyes.
honest_limit.words: Real test: 94% handed back to people.

not_this.body: Stopping everything is not safety either.

ending_pattern.body: The fog door stays shut: the same door in the same fog no longer swings by itself, and a person opens it on purpose.
ending_pattern.callback: The door that swung open by itself in bar 1 now stays shut until the whale chooses.

end_belief.body: Make unsure mean stop, not go.

captions.text: It was not sure either way.
No answer gets treated as yes.
When unsure, stop. Go only on clear yes.
Shut until a clear yes arrives.
Harm shuts it. This is fail closed.
We set the lines. The gate keeps them.
Any harm over the line always stops.
Real test: 94% handed back to people.
Stopping everything is not safety either.
Make unsure mean stop, not go.
